verdict.rationale: Blink is an iOS terminal with its own local command set (cat, grep, ls, cp, curl, scp and others) and a VS Code integration. A terminal of this kind could plausibly bundle git, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never mentions a local git or any stash/unstash capability. Running git stash on a remote host over SSH would be a host-platform capability, not Blink's own.
